create_Marker_task: create a Marker task instance with terminate_episode flag for the ALOHA simulation environment
initialize_Marker_episode: initialize a Marker episode to randomly place the pen and cap on the table surface
configure_pen_position_distribution: configure the pen uniform position distribution for random placement across the table area
configure_pen_rotation_distribution: configure the pen z-axis rotation distribution using quaternion from axis angle randomization
review_Marker_class: review the Marker class that loads MuJoCo XML assets and adds them as free entities to the scene
